verdict.rationale: Single-thread CPU performance is a fair question for a laptop processor, so the axis applies. The pack has no independent single-thread benchmark results. Community comments cover memory bandwidth, LLM token rates and vague overall performance praise, and the docs cover AI software and TDP specs, so nothing shows leading single-thread performance.

support.subject: As a power-user, everyday interactive work feels instant — leading single-thread performance shown in independent benchmarks, not just a peak-GHz number on a slide
